front: Quand j'étais petit, j'habitais à la campagne.
pronunciation: [kahn zhay-teh puh-TEE, zhah-bee-teh ah lah kahm-PAN-yuh]
back: When I was little, I lived in the countryside.
context: The imparfait describes the past: situations, habits, background. Endings: -ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient.

front: Nous allions à la plage tous les étés.
pronunciation: [noo zah-lyohn ah lah plazh too lay zay-TAY]
back: We used to go to the beach every summer.
context: Imparfait for repeated habits: 'used to'. Stem = 'nous' form of the present minus -ons (allons → all-).

front: Il faisait très beau ce jour-là.
pronunciation: [eel fuh-zeh treh BOH suh zhoor-LAH]
back: The weather was very nice that day.
context: Imparfait for weather and settings. 'Faisait' is pronounced [fuh-ZEH].

front: Elle était fatiguée, alors elle s'est couchée tôt.
pronunciation: [el ay-teh fah-tee-GAY, ah-lor el seh koo-shay TOH]
back: She was tired, so she went to bed early.
context: Être is the only irregular stem: j'étais, tu étais, il était…

front: Avant, je fumais, mais j'ai arrêté.
pronunciation: [ah-VAHN, zhuh fü-MEH, meh zhay ah-reh-TAY]
back: I used to smoke, but I quit.
context: 'Avant' + imparfait = in the past, used to.

front: Mon grand-père racontait toujours la même histoire.
pronunciation: [mohn grahn-pehr rah-kohn-teh too-zhoor lah mem ees-TWAHR]
back: My grandfather always told the same story.
context: 'Toujours', 'souvent', 'chaque fois' signal the imparfait of habit.

front: À l'époque, on n'avait pas de téléphone portable.
pronunciation: [ah lay-POK, ohn nah-veh pah duh tay-lay-fun por-TAH-bluh]
back: Back then, we didn't have mobile phones.
context: 'À l'époque' = back then.

front: Je lisais quand le téléphone a sonné.
pronunciation: [zhuh lee-zeh kahn luh tay-lay-fun ah soh-NAY]
back: I was reading when the phone rang.
context: Imparfait = ongoing action (was reading); passé composé = the interrupting event (rang).

front: Qu'est-ce que tu faisais hier soir vers vingt heures ?
pronunciation: [kehs-kuh tü fuh-zeh yehr SWAHR vehr van TUHR]
back: What were you doing last night around 8 p.m.?
context: Imparfait for an action in progress at a past moment.

front: Il y avait beaucoup de monde au concert.
pronunciation: [eel yah-veh boh-koo duh MOHND oh kohn-SEHR]
back: There were a lot of people at the concert.
context: 'Il y avait' = there was / there were (imparfait of il y a).

front: La maison était grande et elle avait un beau jardin.
pronunciation: [lah meh-zohn ay-teh GRAHND ay el ah-veh tan boh zhar-DAN]
back: The house was big and it had a lovely garden.
context: Imparfait for describing places in the past.

front: Il était une fois une princesse qui vivait dans un château.
pronunciation: [ee lay-teh tün FWAH ün pran-SES kee vee-veh dahn zan shah-TOH]
back: Once upon a time there was a princess who lived in a castle.
context: 'Il était une fois' = once upon a time: the opening of every French fairy tale.

front: Je voulais te demander quelque chose.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo-leh tuh duh-mahn-day kel-kuh SHOHZ]
back: I wanted to ask you something.
context: Imparfait of politeness: softer than 'je veux'.

front: Je pensais que tu étais déjà parti.
pronunciation: [zhuh pahn-seh kuh tü ay-teh day-zhah par-TEE]
back: I thought you had already left.
context: Thoughts and opinions in the past usually take the imparfait.

front: Si on allait au cinéma ?
pronunciation: [see ohn nah-leh oh see-nay-MAH]
back: How about going to the cinema?
context: 'Si' + imparfait = a suggestion: how about…?

front: Si j'avais le temps, j'apprendrais le japonais.
pronunciation: [see zhah-veh luh TAHN, zhah-prahn-dreh luh zhah-poh-NEH]
back: If I had the time, I'd learn Japanese.
context: Hypothesis: si + imparfait, then conditional.

front: Nous mangions souvent chez ma tante le dimanche.
pronunciation: [noo mahn-zhyohn soo-vahn shay mah tahnt luh dee-MAHNSH]
back: We often ate at my aunt's on Sundays.
context: -ger verbs keep the e before a and o: mangeais, but mangions.

front: Il commençait à pleuvoir quand nous sommes partis.
pronunciation: [eel koh-mahn-seh tah pluh-VWAHR kahn noo sum par-TEE]
back: It was starting to rain when we left.
context: -cer verbs: commençais (ç before a), but commencions.

front: Vous étiez où pendant les vacances ?
pronunciation: [voo zay-tyay OO pahn-dahn lay vah-KAHNS]
back: Where were you during the holidays?
context: 'Vous étiez' = imparfait of être.

front: Ils jouaient dans le jardin pendant que nous préparions le repas.
pronunciation: [eel zhoo-eh dahn luh zhar-DAN pahn-dahn kuh noo pray-pah-ryohn luh ruh-PAH]
back: They were playing in the garden while we were preparing the meal.
context: Two simultaneous ongoing actions: both imparfait. 'Pendant que' = while.

front: J'adorais les dessins animés quand j'étais enfant.
pronunciation: [zhah-doh-reh lay deh-san zah-nee-MAY kahn zhay-teh zahn-FAHN]
back: I loved cartoons when I was a child.
context: Feelings and preferences in the past: imparfait.

front: Elle portait toujours un chapeau rouge.
pronunciation: [el por-teh too-zhoor zan shah-poh ROOZH]
back: She always wore a red hat.
context: Habitual description.

front: On se voyait tous les jours au lycée.
pronunciation: [ohn suh vwah-yeh too lay zhoor oh lee-SAY]
back: We used to see each other every day at high school.
context: 'Le lycée' = high school (ages 15–18).

front: Il était tard et les rues étaient désertes.
pronunciation: [ee lay-teh TAR ay lay rü ay-teh day-ZEHRT]
back: It was late and the streets were deserted.
context: Setting the scene at the start of a story.

front: Je ne savais pas que tu parlais russe !
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh sah-veh pah kuh tü par-leh RÜS]
back: I didn't know you spoke Russian!
context: 'Savoir' in the past is usually imparfait: je savais, je ne savais pas.

front: Tu avais quel âge quand tu as déménagé ?
pronunciation: [tü ah-veh kel AHZH kahn tü ah day-may-nah-ZHAY]
back: How old were you when you moved?
context: Age in the past = imparfait of avoir.

front: Ma mère travaillait comme infirmière.
pronunciation: [mah mehr trah-vah-yeh kum an-feer-MYEHR]
back: My mother worked as a nurse.
context: A past situation over time.

front: Chaque été, nous partions en Bretagne.
pronunciation: [shak ay-TAY, noo par-tyohn ahn bruh-TAN-yuh]
back: Every summer, we went to Brittany.
context: 'Chaque' + time = habit → imparfait.

front: Il neigeait depuis trois jours.
pronunciation: [eel neh-zheh duh-pwee trwah ZHOOR]
back: It had been snowing for three days.
context: Imparfait + depuis = had been doing.

front: C'était le bon temps !
pronunciation: [seh-teh luh bohn TAHN]
back: Those were the days!
context: 'C'était' = imparfait of c'est. Nostalgic exclamation.

front: Autrefois, ce quartier était très pauvre.
pronunciation: [oh-truh-FWAH, suh kar-tyay ay-teh treh POH-vruh]
back: In the past, this neighborhood was very poor.
context: 'Autrefois' = formerly.

front: Je croyais que c'était gratuit.
pronunciation: [zhuh krwah-yeh kuh seh-teh grah-TWEE]
back: I thought it was free.
context: 'Croire' → je croyais.

front: Il fallait réserver à l'avance.
pronunciation: [eel fah-leh ray-zehr-vay ah lah-VAHNS]
back: You had to book in advance.
context: 'Il faut' → il fallait.

front: Nous étions tellement heureux à cette époque.
pronunciation: [noo zay-tyohn tel-mahn uh-RUH ah set ay-POK]
back: We were so happy at that time.
context: 'À cette époque' = at that time.

front: Pendant que je dormais, quelqu'un a sonné à la porte.
pronunciation: [pahn-dahn kuh zhuh dor-MEH, kel-kan ah soh-nay ah lah PORT]
back: While I was sleeping, someone rang the doorbell.
context: Ongoing (imparfait) interrupted by a single event (passé composé).
